blind.table_distance_name: pile of grain with bucket and shovels
blind.description: A stylized heap of golden-orange threshed grain resting flat on the ground. A small circular wooden bucket banded with metal sits at the edge filled with grain, and two wooden spades or shovels are thrust handle-up into an indentation on the opposite side of the heap. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or unpainted patches.
blind.from_above: A largely circular orange mound with a slight cone peak, flanked on the upper edge by a small circular wooden bucket and on the right by two protruding shovel handles.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 feet tall to the tops of the shovel handles (roughly one-third of the figure's height) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide at the base.

match.reads_as: pile of grain with bucket and shovels
